problem_statement: Build a brand-new /now page from scratch for the Gatsby portfolio site (LekoArts gatsby-starter-portfolio-cara). The /now route currently does not exist — its page component renders nothing (empty fragment), so visiting /now yields a blank document. Create a complete, statically-rendered '/now' page (a snapshot of what the author is currently focused on, in the spirit of the /now page movement). Author it as src/pages/now.tsx so Gatsby's file-based routing serves it at /now. Reuse the site's existing theme-ui design system (Layout, Seo, and the Themed typography components) so the new page inherits the site's dark background, orange accent, spacing scale and fonts. All content must be present in the server-rendered HTML (no client-only Parallax), matching the provided design anchor.
required_content: An intro paragraph describing the page as 'a snapshot of what' the author is focused on right now (mentions the /now page movement)
A 'Work' section: an <h2> 'Work' heading followed by a paragraph about building a small design-systems studio and front-end engagements
A 'Learning' section: an <h2> 'Learning' heading followed by a paragraph about going deep on Rust and typography
A 'Life' section: an <h2> 'Life' heading followed by a paragraph about moving to a quieter part of town and coastal hikes
A closing paragraph noting when the page was last updated and inviting the reader to share what they are focused on
design_constraints: Reuse the site's theme-ui design system — wrap the page in the existing Layout component and use the Themed.h1/h2/p typography primitives rather than raw HTML tags styled from scratch
Use the existing Seo component for the document head (title 'Now')
Inherit the site palette (dark #141821 background, orange primary) and spacing scale via the theme sx prop; do not introduce a new color scheme
Content must be server-side rendered into static HTML (document flow, not absolutely-positioned Parallax layers) so it is present without client JS
Constrain the readable column width (max ~48rem, centered) consistent with the site's typographic rhythm

Typographic scale from the design anchor: the <h1> 'Now' title is the largest heading (desktop ~72px / mobile ~48px, weight 700); the three section <h2> headings (Work, Learning, Life) are one step smaller (desktop ~48px / mobile ~30px, weight 700) and share the same style.

Vertical section rhythm: page order is h1 'Now' + intro paragraph, then the three h2 sections each as an

heading immediately followed by its body

, then a closing paragraph — headings and paragraphs flow in normal document order (no absolutely-positioned layers).
author_notes: 方案A: baseline 的 src/pages/now.tsx 只渲染 <React.Fragment/>(空占位,/now 空白); reference 完整实现 h1+intro+Work/Learning/Life 三段+收尾段; bad 故意只保留 h1+intro+占位段,删掉全部 h2 分区 → 触发目标 dom_assertions 失败。三份工作区 now.tsx 源码 md5 互不相同(baseline 2f42a8c4 / reference 4176d301 / bad 5dcc8271)。
